Question 15
?

Let f(x,y,z)=xyz. Find the linear approximation of f at the point (1,−1,−1).

a
f(x,y,z)≈−2y+z
b
f(x,y,z)≈1+x+z
c
f(x,y,z)≈2+x+y+z
d
f(x,y,z)≈2+x+2y
e
f(x,y,z)≈−2+x−y−z
